messages:
Marc (Hiring): FYI — Rachel (cc'd) got an offer. Wants to start Tue May 12. She's coming from Toronto on a TN and plans to activate at the border. Any HR/payroll/benefits blockers?
Emily (People Ops): Short answer: we can support a POE start but need to prep docs and I-9 plan. Couple items: support letter, recruiter checklist, payments timeline, and a contingency if CBP delays.
Marc (Hiring): what's the usual risk at POE? Could she be denied and we'd be stuck?
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Risk is low for a straightforward TN but not zero. CBP can ask for more proof of non-immigrant intent/role. We'll prepare a standard employer support letter and provide a counsel contact number. If denied, she can't work until status resolved — so have a fallback (delayed start or remote unpaid onboarding).
Alex (Payroll): Important: I-9 physical verification must happen within 3 business days of start. If she crosses and shows I-9 docs in-person to our rep, payroll can run normally. If not, we can't put her on payroll until verified. Also need completed tax forms and banka info before cutoff for first pay.
Nancy (Recruiter): Rachel, can you confirm which POE and tentative arrival time? We'll coordinate an in-person I-9 verifier nearby or ask you to present docs on day 1.
Rachel (Candidate): I can be at Peace Arch/Surrey POE on Mon May 11 evening or TS/BC on Tue morning. Prefer May 11 evening. I can bring passport, CV, offer email, and a physical letter if you send it.
Emily (People Ops): Great. Proposed process: 1) We email signed support letter and copy of offer to you and CBP if requested. 2) You present docs at POE and advise CBP you're entering on TN for X role. 3) Once landed, schedule in-person I-9 with our local verifier within 3 business days — we can arrange Seattle office or authorized representative in Bellingham. 4) Benefits enrollment will open at hire but coverage effective date is linked to payroll/start; payroll needs full packet before cutoff.
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Sample support letter (we'll edit company letterhead and sign):
```
To: U.S. Customs and Border Protection
Re: Rachel Patel — TN Entry

This letter confirms that Redwood Inference is offering Rachel Patel the position of Software Engineer (Full-time) beginning May 12, 2026. Duties, salary, and employer contact are included below. Redwood requests inspection and admission for TN classification for temporary entry. If CBP requires confirmation, please contact our immigration attorney Priya Rao at priya@lawco.com or +1-206-555-0123.

Position: Software Engineer
SOC/Category: Computer Systems Analyst / Software Engineer
Salary: $145,000 USD per year
Duration: Ongoing full-time employment
Employer contact: Marc Lee, marc@redwood.com, +1-415-555-0199
```
Emily (People Ops): We'll attach that signed letter and a PDF of the offer. Nancy will coordinate a verifier near the POE for May 11 evening.
Alex (Payroll): If verifier confirms I-9 on 5/12, we can include her in payroll for the next run. If verification slips past payroll cutoff, we can do retro pay, but we need bank & tax forms submitted by 5/10 ideally.
Marc (Hiring): OK — thanks team. Rachel, please confirm exact POE time and we'll finalize verifier location + send the letter.
Rachel (Candidate): Confirmed — crossing May 11 at ~7pm Peace Arch. Thanks, will bring originals.
Emily (People Ops): Noted. Nancy will DM verifier details and send the signed letter + offer PDF here in thread. @Priya — can you cc counsel phone in the final PDF?
Priya (Immigration Counsel): Yes, will include counsel contact and sign.
imm-legal-bot: reminder: add case note for TN start in candidate file and set tile reminder 48h before start. :white_check_mark:
Marc (Hiring): Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
